The power tailgate simplifies loading and unloading, transforming routine tasks into convenient operations. This 2023 F-150 Raptor stands ready to serve as your dependable partner, whether you prioritize capability, comfort, or both. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this truck firsthand and discuss how it fits your needs.

- LED Lighting Group with Daytime Running Lamps and Front Fog Lamps

The gray exterior gives this Wrangler a modern appearance while maintaining its iconic presence on the road. The 3.6-liter V6 engine delivers dependable power, paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and 4WD capability to handle varied terrain and weather conditions. With EPA ratings of 19 city and 22 highway MPG, this Wrangler balances performance with practical fuel efficiency.

Inside, the cabin reflects the Altitude trim's premium touches. Leather-trimmed bucket seats provide comfort for daily commutes and longer journeys. The Uconnect 4C navigation system with its 8.4-inch touchscreen integrates seamlessly into your driving experience, offering GPS guidance, Apple CarPlay, and Android Auto connectivity. The Alpine premium audio system ensures quality sound whether you're streaming music or enjoying satellite radio through the included SiriusXM services.

Safety and convenience features are built into this vehicle's design. The advanced safety group includes blind spot detection and cross path monitoring to enhance visibility. The rear park assist system and backup camera help with precision parking and maneuvering. Remote start capability allows you to prepare your vehicle before stepping outside, while the heated steering wheel and seats provide comfort during colder months.

This Wrangler's versatility extends to outdoor pursuits and practical needs. The body color hard top protects your cargo while maintaining the classic Wrangler aesthetic. If you've been searching for a 2021 Land Rover Defender 110 for sale in San Diego, CA, this X Sport Utility 4D at Siry Motors - San Diego is exactly what you've been looking for. With 58,110 miles, a turbocharged mild-hybrid inline-six under the hood, and full-time AWD capability, this Defender 110 hits the sweet spot between everyday luxury and genuine off-road credibility all at a compelling $48,900 price point.

===== About This 2021 Land Rover Defender 110 =====

The Defender nameplate was reborn for the modern era in 2020, and the 2021 model year represents the first full production cycle of this iconic SUV in its entirely new form. At just over 58,000 miles, this example sits comfortably in the middle of its usable life broken in, but with plenty of road ahead. The 110 designation refers to the longer wheelbase variant, which gives you a proper three-row-capable platform with rear passenger room that the shorter 90 simply can't match. For San Diego families, adventure seekers, or professionals who want a capable, head-turning SUV without paying new-car money, this is a serious opportunity.

===== 2021 Land Rover Defender 110 Performance and Engine =====

==== Turbocharged Mild-Hybrid Inline-Six Power ====

Under the hood sits Land Rover's 3.0-liter, turbocharged mild-hybrid six-cylinder engine an intelligent powertrain that pairs a 48-volt MHEV system with the combustion engine to improve efficiency and reduce turbo lag at low speeds. In real-world driving, this translates to brisk acceleration on the freeway, smooth power delivery in city traffic, and a level of refinement that older body-on-frame SUVs simply couldn't offer. The 8-speed automatic transmission shifts seamlessly whether you're navigating the 5 or heading east on the 8 toward the mountains.

AWD is standard, and Land Rover's Terrain Response system gives you selectable drive modes engineered for everything from loose sand to rock crawling. For San Diego County drivers who enjoy weekend trips to Anza-Borrego, the Julian foothills, or Baja California, the Defender's off-road credentials aren't just marketing they're genuinely tested and proven.

===== Land Rover Defender 110 Features and Interior =====

==== What the X Trim Brings to the Table ====

The X trim represents the top of the Defender lineup, positioned above SE, HSE, and S trims. That means this vehicle was optioned to the hilt from the factory. Expect premium interior materials, sport front seats, a large Pivi Pro infotainment touchscreen, a premium audio system, and a heightened level of interior finish that rivals true luxury SUVs. The 110's longer body gives rear occupants generous legroom, and the flat load floor makes cargo management far more practical than many competitors.

Modern tech features on the Defender X typically include a digital instrument cluster, wireless phone connectivity, advanced driver assistance systems, and Land Rover's configurable terrain management. This is not a stripped-down adventure rig it's a luxury SUV that also happens to be formidably capable off-road.

===== Land Rover Defender Reliability and Ownership =====

The reborn Defender launched to strong critical acclaim, but prospective buyers should understand the ownership picture clearly. Early examples 2020 model year especially had some teething issues typical of a ground-up redesign. The 2021 model year saw meaningful refinements, and owners generally report high satisfaction with the driving dynamics, technology, and off-road performance.

Land Rover ownership does carry higher maintenance costs than mainstream brands, and servicing should be performed at qualified Land Rover technicians or experienced independent shops familiar with the platform. The MHEV system has proven reliable, and the 3.0-liter inline-six is a robust unit shared across the broader Jaguar Land Rover line>

2017 Mercedes-Benz S550 Cabriolet | Anthracite Blue Metallic over Porcelain | 41,500 Miles

Mercedes went forty-four years without building a four-seat S-Class convertible. Then, briefly, they did, and then stopped again. You can own this a decade and never pull up beside another one.

THE COLOR
Anthracite Blue Metallic photographs as black. Park it in afternoon sun and a deep navy rises out of the paint. With the black soft top and 20-inch AMG wheels in graphite, the car reads as one continuous dark shape. Then you open the door.

THE INTERIOR
Porcelain leather across the seats, doors, dash and console, with espresso brown over the upper dash and door tops. Burl walnut inlays and a wood-and-leather steering wheel most of these cars never got.

HOW IT DRIVES
4.7L twin-turbo V8, 449 hp, 516 lb-ft, nine-speed automatic. Zero to sixty in the mid fours, though that isn't the point. It never sounds like it's working. It gathers the horizon in and hands it to you. AIRMATIC reads the road and adjusts before you reach the bump instead of after.

THE TOP
Fully lined acoustic soft top, up or down in about twenty seconds at speeds to 37 mph, so a shower at a stoplight is no crisis. Closed, the cabin is nearly as quiet as the sedan. Open, AIRCAP deflects turbulence over the cabin and AIRSCARF warms your neck from the headrests. Comfortable roof-down at 55 degrees.

EQUIPMENT
Heated, ventilated and massaging front seats. Burmester surround audio. 360-degree camera. Adaptive cruise, lane keeping, blind spot monitor. Ambient lighting that sounds like a gimmick until you drive home at night with the top down. Plus a factory-integrated Apple CarPlay retrofit through the original COMAND screen and controller, which Mercedes never offered on these cars.

SERVICE
Annual service completed and all spark plugs replaced July 2026. New Goodyear run-flats installed by the dealer June 2026.

41,500 miles is under 4,700 a year, driven the way an S-Class Cabriolet should be. On good days.

The 2026 Kia Carnival Hybrid SX Prestige is a premium 4-door passenger van that blends turbocharged hybrid performance, luxurious passenger comfort, and exceptional family versatility. Finished in Ceramic Silver with an Off-Black leather interior and showing just 4,876 miles, this Carnival Hybrid pairs a 1.6-liter turbocharged 4-cylinder hybrid powertrain with a 6-speed automatic transmission and front-wheel drive. Four-wheel independent suspension and speed-sensing steering help create composed road manners for everything from the daily school run to long family road trips.

The SX Prestige cabin turns travel into a first-class experience. Heated and ventilated leather front seats, power front seating, driver memory, a heated leather-wrapped steering wheel, and dual-zone automatic climate control put comfort front and center. Second-row passengers receive special treatment with heated and ventilated power VIP Lounge Seats, while the reclining split-bench third row adds flexibility for additional passengers. Front and second-row power moonroofs bring extra light into the cabin, and rear air conditioning helps keep everyone comfortable. A head-up display places useful driving information within your natural line of sight.

Navigation helps keep family adventures on course, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integrate compatible smartphone features. A 12-speaker audio system with SiriusXM capability provides the soundtrack, and the listed Rear Seat Entertainment Package with dual-screen rear entertainment gives passengers another way to enjoy longer journeys. HomeLink, an auto-dimming rearview mirror, ambient lighting, laminated second-row windows, and illuminated interior details further enhance the premium atmosphere.

Active cruise control can make highway travel more relaxing, while a rearview camera adds useful visibility when reversing. Automatic high beams, fully automatic headlights, fog lights, rain-sensing wipers, brake assist, electronic stability control, traction control, ABS, four-wheel disc brakes, and multiple airbags provide additional confidence. The power liftgate simplifies loading, while split-folding rear seating, a cargo tray and cargo net help the Carnival adapt to passengers, luggage, and everyday gear. Nineteen-inch Black D-Cut alloy wheels and a rear spoiler complete its upscale appearance.

This vehicle is a previous service loaner. With only 4,876 miles, it offers an appealing opportunity to enjoy a lightly driven Carnival Hybrid with premium appointments and outstanding passenger versatility.

Schedule your test drive today and experience this 2026 Kia Carnival Hybrid SX Prestige for yourself. Its low mileage, hybrid powertrain, VIP Lounge seating, premium technology, and flexible three-row cabin make it an exceptional choice for family travel.

This 2024 Ford F-250SD Lariat in Rapid Red Metallic combines capability with premium features for those who demand both performance and refinement. Finished in striking red with meticulous attention to detail, this truck stands ready for serious work or weekend adventure. With its commanding presence and advanced technology suite, this Lariat represents a significant step up in truck sophistication and capability.

- B&O Unleashed Sound System by Bang & Olufsen with 14 speakers and subwoofer
- Intelligent Adaptive Cruise Control with Stop-and-Go and lane centering
- Pro Trailer Backup Assist with trailer reverse guidance
- Ford Co-Pilot 360 2.0 with Pre-Collision Assist and Automatic Emergency Braking
- FX4 Off-Road Package with Hill Descent Control and off-road tuned shock absorbers
- Head-Up Display
- 20 Chrome PVD Aluminum wheels with chrome package trim
- High Capacity 11.6 Axle Upgrade Package
- Electronic-Locking differential with 3.55 axle ratio
- Rapid-Heat Supplemental Cab Heater with dual 68 AH AGM batteries
- Tailgate Step & Handle
- Connected Navigation with complimentary 1-year trial
- Wireless Charging Pad
- 6 Angular Bright Anodized Step Bars with chrome door handles
- SYNC 4 with Enhanced Voice Recognition

The heart of this truck is the 6.7L Power Stroke V8 diesel engine paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD capability. This powertrain delivers the torque and towing prowess you expect from a heavy-duty Super Duty, backed by features like manual push-button engine-exhaust braking and Operator Commanded Regeneration for maximum control. The truck carries the FX4 Off-Road Package, which includes transfer case and fuel tank skid plates, hill descent control, and specifically tuned off-road suspension that enhances capability on challenging terrain.

The Lariat Ultimate Package elevates the interior with genuine luxury appointments including leather-trimmed front seats with heating and ventilation, a heated steering wheel, and power adjustability. The 4-way adjustable headrests and memory settings ensure comfort tailored to your preferences. Premium sound fills the cabin through the B&O Unleashed system, while SYNC 4 provides intuitive connectivity and voice command control.

Safety and convenience technology are comprehensive throughout. Ford Co-Pilot 360 2.0 includes forward collision warning with automatic emergency braking, pedestrian detection, lane-keeping systems with alert and aid functions, and BLIS with cross-traffic alert. The Pro Trailer Hitch Assist simplifies hookup, while the rear view camera and reverse sensing system provide confidence in tight spaces. Six upfitter switches in the overhead console accommodate aftermarket equipment for those who customize their trucks.

The exterior receives careful attention with the Chrome Package adding visual distinction through chrome tow hooks, mirror caps, door handles, and exhaust tip. The step bars provide functional access without sacrificing style. LED roof clearance lights, rear wheel well liners, and an all-weather floor mat protect against the elements while maintaining appearance.
